headline: US Job Openings Rise to 7.5 Million in September
summary: U.S. job openings increased to 7.5 million in September as hiring activity rose and layoffs declined, pointing to potential stabilization in the labor market.
why: Job openings data from the JOLTS report serves as a key indicator of labor demand and wage pressure for the Federal Reserve.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Higher job openings reflect robust labor demand.
